# Copilot Instructions

Apply these project-specific instructions by default:

- Use a filter dropdown menu for menu items when there are more than 5 items in the menu.
- Improve fixNames.txt by adding instructor mappings for very close variants of the same instructor name.
- Treat capitalization-only differences as the same instructor.
- Treat first-initial versus spelled-out first-name variants as the same instructor only when the mapping is unambiguous.
- Treat middle-name or middle-initial additions as the same instructor only when the mapping is unambiguous.
- Record new user instructions for this project in ~/ailog using the file pattern 01shortAIproject-YYYY-MM-DD-ai-instructions.md, with a timestamp on each entry.
